scope: Independent read-only review of native first freeze (7 files) plus service second freeze (3 files,4 tests); no source changes, Cargo/rustc, Windows/SSH/native/CI execution. Not a runtime or compatibility pass.

findings.conclusion: One physical FLIGHT is claimed before store open. All cooperative-cancel/native-failure paths explicitly close original owner before released; checked key/cert failures retain original dependencies, and a failed cleanup keeps an inert ManuallyDrop exact owner in the permanently Faulted process singleton. Cancelled is never used as physical completion. Native resources stay on creator thread; no native operation spans the metadata lock.

Server-auth RequestedUsage is explicit. SSL policy success requires BOOL true and dwError==0 and clean chain trust; API failure/nonzero policy are not interpreted as success. EKU flags0 use documented effective extension/property semantics; successful zero-count is separated by immediate GetLastError. CallerFree false keeps key with selected certificate, true closes the correct CNG/CSP handle. CHECK store false consumes handle exactly once, consistent with official always-closed contract.

Fresh exact Local Manage session plus GlobalAdmin/no must-change checked before SQL/native and repeatedly afterward; original expected settings and identity are read coherently through sole writer, and repository precommit checks original review authority. Any global publication/health/generation change makes review stale, including non-identity settings saves. Ledger contention is recoverable AuthorityUnavailable. Backend/ledger/writer locks do not span native query; caller must obey the factory composition contract to release its Backend mutex before inspect.

Service requires a bound execution fence, AND-composes later fences, never stores JobContext or creates a replacement deadline, and propagates original fence into SQL. Actual worker model test retains running job after cancel until query returns and real pool join. Actual CryptoAPI calls remain synchronous/uninterruptible; query completion/OS allocation limits are not asserted.

No cross-request live certificate cache/start permission is implemented. Observation contains timestamped historical facts. is_current_for only correlates original configuration/publication/session, not passage of certificate validity time; it has no TTL or new trust query. UI must retain checked-at wording and its usual exact-session delivery gate, never reinterpret this method as proof that certificate is still valid now or listener may start. Revocation is local cache-only chain-excluding-root; IP name remains Unverified, private key acquisition is not signing proof.

remainingVerification: Parent compilation must establish GNU/MSVC signature/cfg compatibility; this review did not run compiler.

Real Windows CurrentUser MY tests must cover missing/found cert, wrong name, expired cert, no/failed silent key, trust/revocation errors and actual cleanup; existing injected tests are explicitly models.
No claim of client trust, online revocation freshness, TLS handshake, bounded arbitrary native provider duration, production listener eligibility or P0 closure.

primarySources.use: BOOL indicates policy evaluation; actual dwError is required, revocation delegated to chain build.
Current-user default chain, both independent cache-only flags, explicit root auto-update suppression, returned chain cleanup.
Effective EKU extension/property combination; successful zero-count uses immediate last error to distinguish unrestricted from no uses.
Silent/no-healing behavior; cached-key comparison caveat and CallerFree-dependent release.
CHECK false still closes store, forbids retrying same consumed handle.
